adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.attack_theFixIsInert: ATTEMPTED REFUTE the whole change from the artifact side: if the composed line reached the payload but not the CARD, the probe would pass on a line a customer never sees. CHECKED: the probe reads the card payload itself (`/api/spine/property-atoms/<id>/facets`), which is the same wire the card renders from; the composer is wired into deriveBakedCardModel (the model the card renders) AND into fact-sheet-resolver's identity line, and both the card-model and the identity paths are exercised by tests in this lane's file list.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.attack_theMCPHalfIsUnproven: ATTEMPTED REFUTE the MCP leg: the MCP's gate refuses this seat (401 missing_bearer, so the probe's MCP leg did not measure and says so). The LDT half is therefore proven by unit tests over the real composer (44 tests, 5 of which fail without the change), NOT by a live MCP call. The predicate says so in its own basis text ('the MCP leg did not measure, so its half is not graded') rather than implying a pass. Named as a residual for the integration seat: the MCP half has no live reading in this lane.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.attack_anUNMEASUREDhidesAFailure: ATTEMPTED REFUTE the UNMEASURED branch: a predicate that returns UNMEASURED whenever it cannot grade is a way to go green by not looking. CHECKED against the measured subject: the payload DOES carry a ledger city (Pflugerville, via cityLimits with the roll's declared absence), so the predicate cannot take the UNMEASURED branch here and returns FAIL. The self-test asserts the UNMEASURED branch only for a payload carrying neither component, and asserts the FAIL branch fires on the live shape.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.attack_theGuardsAreVacuous: ATTEMPTED REFUTE the guards by asking what would still pass if the fix were reverted: measured, the guards pass in BOTH directions, so they do not detect this fix — by design, since their job is to catch the neighbouring mistake (an INVENTED city or ZIP). What detects the fix is the five-case block that failed pre-change.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.attack_aCleanMergeIsAGreenMerge: REFUSED that shortcut in writing: merge-tree says this lane merges cleanly with #421, #422 and #423, and the merged trees carry both lanes' changes, but all four shared files sit in the facet-composition seam, so the SECOND lander must re-run its own suite. Recorded in CP1's crossLaneFileSharing for the integration seat.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint2.verdict: ACCEPTED with three residuals declared for the integration seat: the live situsZip rail's serve state, the live MCP leg, and the PDF leg.
